bonus.q: Hvad viser en Muiderberg-åbning på 2♥ eller 2♠?
bonus.correct: En femfarve i majoren, mindst fire kort i en ukendt minor og ca. 5–10 hp
options: En femfarve i majoren, mindst fire kort i en ukendt minor og ca. 5–10 hp
En seksfarve i majoren og ca. 5–10 hp
En femfarve i majoren, mindst fire kort i en ukendt minor og 11–15 hp
bonus.why: 2♥/2♠ viser en femfarve i majoren og mindst fire kort i en ukendt minor med ca. 5–10 hp. Med en seksfarve i majoren åbnes Multi 2♦.

bonus.q: What does a Muiderberg opening of 2♥ or 2♠ show?
bonus.correct: A five-card major, at least four cards in an unknown minor and about 5–10 HCP
options: A five-card major, at least four cards in an unknown minor and about 5–10 HCP
A six-card major and about 5–10 HCP
A five-card major, at least four cards in an unknown minor and 11–15 HCP
bonus.why: 2♥/2♠ shows a five-card major and at least four cards in an unknown minor with about 5–10 HCP. With a six-card major the opening is Multi 2♦.

bonus.q: Hvad betyder 3♣ som svar på Muiderberg?
bonus.correct: Pas eller ret: ønske om at spille i åbners minor
options: Pas eller ret: ønske om at spille i åbners minor
bonus.why: 3♣ er pas eller ret: svarer vil spille i åbners minor. Åbner passer med klør og melder 3♦ med ruder. Det stærke spørgebud er 2NT.

bonus.q: What does 3♣ mean in response to Muiderberg?
bonus.correct: Pass or correct: to play in opener's minor
options: Pass or correct: to play in opener's minor
Natural with responder's own club suit
bonus.why: 3♣ is pass or correct: responder wants to play in opener's minor. Opener passes with clubs and bids 3♦ with diamonds. The strong enquiry is 2NT.

options: Pas, fordi 3♣ er svarers egen farve
bonus.why: 3♣ er pas eller ret: svarer vil spille i åbners minor. Åbner passer med klør og melder 3♦ med ruder.
